blocks.title: Material
blocks.text: Material koi bhi substance (maddah) ya substances ka mixture hai jis se rozana zindagi ya industry ki koi ahem cheez banti hai, maslan plastics, metals, ceramics, building material waghera.

Materials ki thermal (heat se related), mechanical (maslan hardness yani sakhti, aur elasticity yani lachak) aur chemical properties bohat achhi hoti hain. Inhein samajhne ke liye teen cheezein dekhi jati hain: material ki composition (kis cheez se bana hai), us ke chemical bonds ki qism, aur us ki microstructure (andar ki bohat chhoti banawat). Kisi khaas kaam ke liye material us ki physical, chemical, mechanical, electrical aur thermal characteristics (khoobiyon) ko dekh kar chuna jata hai. Agle hisson mein different materials aur un ki properties parhenge.

blocks.alt: Paanch rangeen boxes (khane): Metals and alloys (steel, aluminium), Ceramics (bricks, glass), Polymers (plastics, rubber), Composites (fibreglass) aur Semiconductors (Si, GaAs, GaN).
blocks.caption: Materials ki paanch qismein aur un ki misalein (hamari apni drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Kaun si teen cheezein kisi material ki properties samajhne mein madad deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Us ki composition, us ke chemical bonds ki qism, aur us ki microstructure.

items: Material se rozana zindagi ya industry ki cheezein banti hain.
Properties composition, bonding aur microstructure se samajh aati hain.
Agle topics: metals aur alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, semiconductors.
